page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, totaling 8 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.se1.2xlarge is positioned in the lower tiers for raw compute and memory speed. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, along with Geekbench scores, fall into the weak to poor categories. However, the instance demonstrates average performance in uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidth, as well as Passmark CPU physics and extended instruction tests. Redis SET operations and prompt processing for small 135M LLM models also achieve average tier results, while larger model inference and cryptographic operations show weaker performance.

Given its high memory density relative to compute power, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not demand high-frequency CPU performance. The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage. The ecs.se1.2xlarge is suited for memory-intensive applications such as caching layers, in-memory databases, and lightweight data processing tasks where RAM capacity is prioritized over raw processing speed.
